insight: Famously bootstraps on itself — Aider writes a large share of its own releases (often 60-80% of each version's code).
name: Aider
tagline: Terminal-native pair programmer. BYO key, BYO model.
description: Open-source CLI for AI pair-programming directly against your git repo. Brings any model (Claude, Gemini, GPT, local) into a tight commit-per-task loop.
edge: CLI-only and model-agnostic: auto-commits every AI edit as its own git commit, so changes are trivially revertable.
pros: Works with any model incl. local
Strong on its own Polyglot benchmark
cons: You pay model API costs yourself
